decisions.difference: A: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Nose finding" "finding"))  vs  B: (or Nasal discharge, Nasal congestion, Bleeding from nose)
decisions.reason: The box says "patient with nose symptoms", a general complaint; Will's briefing prefers the general concept in due_to because descendants match, and all three of B's concepts are descendants of Nose finding.

decisions.difference: A: second task "Check for causes of blocked or runny nose" due_to (or Nasal discharge, Nasal obstruction)  vs  B: "Check for causes of nose symptoms" due_to (or Nasal discharge, Nasal congestion, Bleeding from nose)
decisions.final_expr: "Check for causes of nose symptoms" with due_to (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Nose finding" "finding"))
decisions.reason: The causes task covers the approach box (diphtheria, for any nose symptom) and both symptom columns (blocked/runny and bleeding), so it takes the page's general "nose symptoms" trigger.

decisions.difference: A: urgent task also checks for diphtheria features, column symptoms, sneezing, itch  vs  B: urgent task checks only the red-box items; the rest is in a separate causes task

"Blocked nose" on the page is a symptom; Nasal congestion is the finding form, Nasal obstruction a disorder (A said no finding form exists, but Nasal congestion exists). Applied in check_for and in the common cold, acute viral infection, sinusitis and allergic rhinitis rules.

A: onset >= 4 weeks of itchy/runny/blocked nose unqualified  vs  B: the same with (qualifier Recurrent) on each (and Recurrent forms in check_for)
decisions.final_expr: (>= (onset (clinical_finding ... (qualifier (snomed_concept "Recurrent" "qualifier value")))) (time_ago 4 weeks)) for each of itchy, runny, blocked nose

decisions.reason: The page says "mild fever"; B keeps "mild" and checks for that form (the rule is possible, so it is exempt from the anchoring constraint).

decisions.final_expr: (or (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Repetitive rubbing of body parts" "finding") (finding_site (snomed_concept "Nasal structure" "body structure"))) (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Itching" "finding") (finding_site (snomed_concept "Nasal structure" "body structure"))))
decisions.reason: The page says "continually rubbing or itchy nose"; B encodes both alternatives, and rubbing is an existing concept (its behavioural parent is noted as a SNOMED fit question).
